name: Fate Itself
source:
You've been granted the opportunity to see into the future. And while yours is bright, the future of those that you love will not be as fortunate. How far will you go to change fate?

[From [url=https://killingfantasy.itch.io/fateitself]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已经获得了展望未来的机会。虽然你的未来很光明，但你所爱的人的未来却不会那么幸运。为了改变命运，你愿意走多远？

[来自[url=https://killingfantasy.itch.io/fateitself]Itch.io[/url]]
